definitions: To attract or entice someone or something.
To make something shorter or smaller; to contract.
To arrive at a station (for a train or bus).
To make the days become shorter (referring to winter).
examples: The concert hoped to draw in a large crowd.
The tailor had to draw in the waist of the trousers.
The train is expected to draw in at 3 PM.
The evenings are starting to draw in now that autumn is here.
